blindSummary: The dedicated country dossier found no region-specific legal, incident or enforcement finding for this state/province, so its picture rests on the national framework. The 2025 national movement's annual report places this state/province at 1.83% of nationally documented abuse cases (1.56% in 2024) with a +7.69% year-on-year rise in 2025 - inside a national pattern where only the two biggest regions fell while the other 14 rose (national total 3,620 cases, +27.1%, a 24-year record). Local institutional movement was positive: the local municipality convened the commune's first Pride march, and one of the 2025 pride marches that expanded the movement's territorial visibility was held here.
blindSourceSummaries: An international LGBT-rights organisation's overview of this country (updated 12 March 2026): national framework - same-sex marriage and adoption since March 2022; hate-crime law with SOGI aggravation since 2012; civil unions since 2015; self-determination gender-recognition law in force since 2019; third-sex birth designation for intersex children since 2006; no ban on medically unnecessary intersex surgeries on minors but 2023 health-ministry guidance against them; 2025 first conviction for a lesbophobic femicide; societal opinion broadly positive with recent pushback on trans rights after a 2024 parliamentary commission on trans children (final report May 2025). National picture only; no region-specific content.

National LGBTQ news outlet feature (19 March 2025) on a year of regression for LGBTQ rights in this country, used in the dossier's national political-direction note. The cached page body retrieved only site navigation, so this summary rests on the headline and the dossier's citation. No region-specific content.

A national rights movement's 24th annual human-rights report on sexual and gender diversity in this country (2025 facts, published March 2026): national total of 3,620 discrimination cases in 2025, +27.1% and the highest on record (23% of all cases in 24 years); geographic shares - the largest region 46.13%, the second-largest 23.46%, the third 7.2%, and this state/province 1.83% (1.56% in 2024); 2025 movement - this state/province +7.69% while the two largest regions fell; local positivity - the local municipality convened its first Pride march, and this state/province hosted one of the pride marches that expanded the movement's territorial visibility.
